comment: Written BEFORE any code reads NEEDS or OPENS. Each case runs the court forged from door_v40.haro (or, D7, panel_court.haro) on a sentence of door/.

cases.name: a sentence that opens only what the language needs
a SERVICE that lists a door the language does not NEED is refused
cases.first: door (line 2): SERVICE api opens 'filesystem', and the language door does not NEED it

cases.name: the refusal in the envelope: its code, no cites, an error
a word outside the MENU is the MENU's refusal, as it always was
cases.first: A capability is network, process or filesystem

cases.name: the world publishes what each declaration opens: a LISTENER its door, a SERVICE what it lists; a NOTE nothing
a SERVICE that lists nothing, or has no NEEDS seat, opens nothing, and its row says so
a world of a language that NEEDS nothing has no opens: every other court keeps its bytes
